*Amendment 2 to extend the deadline for offers due to none being received.*

*Amendment 1 to update Terms and Conditions in the attachments*

This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) part 8 and 12, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice.  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued.  Solicitation number 70Z03826QS0000002 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ).  This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect as of November 28, 2025, in accordance with (IAW) the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO).

The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 336413.  The small business size standard is 1,250 employees. This notice of intent to award to Basic Ordering Agreement SPE4A1-25-G-0018 is considered an unrestricted requirement.

It is anticipated that a firm-fixed price delivery order will be awarded on sole source basis as a result of this synopsis/solicitation. Contractors having the expertise and capabilities to provide these items are invited to submit offers in accordance with the requirements stipulated in this solicitation.

The following documents are attached:

  • Requirements – 70Z03826QS0000002
  • Terms and Conditions – 70Z03826QS0000002
  • Sole Source Justification – 70Z03826QS0000002

Closing date and time for receipt of offers is 17 February 2026 at 12:00 pm EST. Quotes and questions shall be submitted by email to jeremy.a.wood@uscg.mil.  Please indicate solicitation 70Z03826QS0000002 in the subject line.  Phone calls WILL NOT be accepted.

In accordance with agency procedures, interested parties may request an independent review of the Agency Protest at a level above the Contracting Officer.
